item.title: Watch the aquarium feeding
item.summary: An aquarium announcement tells visitors when and where to watch the fish.
item.transcript_text: Good morning. The fish feeding starts at eleven in the small room, next to the café. Please stand behind the yellow line. You can take photos, but please turn off the flash. There is another feeding at two. The café stays open until four.

questions.prompt: What is the message mainly about?
options: How to watch the fish feeding
How to look after a fish at home
questions.explanation: The speaker tells visitors about the feeding times, location and rules.

options: In the small room next to the café
questions.explanation: The small room beside the café is the location. The café is a landmark.
Eleven is the first feeding and four is the café closing time. The second feeding is at two.

questions.prompt: What should people do with their cameras?
options: Use them with the flash on
questions.explanation: Photos are allowed as long as visitors turn off the flash.
